content.text: No art packs are installed yet. Run the Gallery Shuffle Converter on your art mods; it writes the pack files and this menu's pack pages.
Changes wait until you apply them: press Apply all, or answer Apply all when you leave Gallery Shuffle or the menu. Cancel there puts every setting back to how it was.

content.help: When on, empty canvases and frames also receive pack art. Takes effect once you apply your changes.

When on, every time a save loads the art gets a new arrangement with the same pack shares. When off (the default), the layout stays as it is until you change a setting or press Shuffle layout. Takes effect once you apply your changes.

Applies every change on these pages: after you confirm, the game saves as GShufApply, returns to the main menu and loads that save, so every change shows at once. Leaving Gallery Shuffle or the menu with changes not applied asks the same; Cancel there puts every setting back to how it was.
Picks a new arrangement with the same pack shares. Takes effect once you apply your changes.

Back to defaults: all art vanilla (every pack slider at 0), Pip-Boy screen and skin on Vanilla, blank canvases off, new layout on every load off, layout seed 1, vanilla main menu video. Takes effect once you apply your changes.
